# SmolLM2-135M-Instruct · GGUF

Quantized versions of [HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct) (135M parameters, LlamaForCausalLM). Produced with iQuantize 0.1.0 and measured against the original model in the same runtime.

## Files

| Format | Variant | Size | Bits/weight | Perplexity | KL divergence | Same top token | Use when |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| GGUF | BF16 (original) | 270.9 MB | 16 | 20.712 | 0 | 100% | Reference |
| GGUF | `Q4_K_M` | 105.5 MB | 6.27 | 21.424 | 0.0369 | 88.2% | Best balance for most people |
| GGUF | `Q8_0` | 144.8 MB | 8.61 | 20.779 | 0.0015 | 97.3% | Near-original quality; plenty of memory |
| GGUF | `IQ3_M` | 90.2 MB | 5.37 | 23.160 | 0.1177 | 79.5% | Tight memory; some quality loss |

Lower perplexity and KL divergence are better; "same top token" is how often the quantized model's most likely next token matches the original's.

## How these files were made

1. **GGUF (llama.cpp b11935)**: the original safetensors were converted to a full-precision GGUF with `convert_hf_to_gguf.py`, then quantized with `llama-quantize`.
   An importance matrix was computed with `llama-imatrix` on WikiText-2 (train split) (32 chunks × 512 tokens) so the most important weights keep more precision.
   Some tensors have rows that are not a multiple of 256, so llama.cpp stored them with a 32-wide block type; that is why bits per weight are higher than the type names suggest.
2. **Evaluation**: perplexity and KL divergence were measured on WikiText-2 (test split) (20 chunks × 512 tokens) against the original model in the same runtime.

## Usage

**llama.cpp**

```bash
llama-cli -hf <your-username>/<repo-name>:Q4_K_M -p "Hello"
# or serve an OpenAI-compatible API
llama-server -hf <your-username>/<repo-name>:Q4_K_M
```

**Ollama**

```bash
ollama run hf.co/<your-username>/<repo-name>:Q4_K_M
```

**LM Studio**: search for `<your-username>/<repo-name>` in the model browser.

## Hardware used

Apple M4 Pro · macos · 25.8 GB RAM · accelerators: metal, cpu.

## Limitations

Quantization reduces precision, so outputs can differ from the original model, especially at lower bit widths and on small models. All limitations, biases and license terms of the original model apply.

## Reproduce

<details><summary>Exact commands</summary>

```bash
'<app>/envs/gguf/bin/python' -u '<app>/tools/llama.cpp/src/convert_hf_to_gguf.py' '<workspace>/models/HuggingFaceTB__SmolLM2-135M-Instruct' --outfile '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/convert.tmp.gguf' --outtype auto
'<app>/envs/core/bin/python' -u -I -X utf8 '<app>/drivers/calib_fetch.py' '{"max_chars":102575,"out_path":"<workspace>/calibration/wikitext2-train-102575.txt","preset":"wikitext2-train"}'
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-imatrix' -m '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-AUTO.gguf' -f '<workspace>/calibration/wikitext2-train-102575.txt' -o '<workspace>/cache/gguf/imatrix-290b97930c659438.gguf' --chunks 32 -c 512 -ngl 99
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-quantize' --imatrix '<workspace>/cache/gguf/imatrix-290b97930c659438.gguf' '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-AUTO.gguf' '<workspace>/outputs/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct/gguf/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf' Q4_K_M
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-quantize' --imatrix '<workspace>/cache/gguf/imatrix-290b97930c659438.gguf' '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-AUTO.gguf' '<workspace>/outputs/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct/gguf/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-IQ3_M.gguf' IQ3_M
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-quantize' --imatrix '<workspace>/cache/gguf/imatrix-290b97930c659438.gguf' '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-AUTO.gguf' '<workspace>/outputs/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct/gguf/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf' Q8_0
'<app>/envs/core/bin/python' -u -I -X utf8 '<app>/drivers/calib_fetch.py' '{"max_chars":71609,"out_path":"<workspace>/calibration/wikitext2-test-71609.txt","preset":"wikitext2-test"}'
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-perplexity' -m '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-AUTO.gguf' --chunks 20 -c 512 -ngl 99 -f '<workspace>/calibration/wikitext2-test-71609.txt' --kl-divergence-base '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/kld-7c416e92af5ce916.bin'
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-perplexity' -m '<workspace>/outputs/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct/gguf/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf' --chunks 20 -c 512 -ngl 99 --kl-divergence-base '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/kld-7c416e92af5ce916.bin' --kl-divergence
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-perplexity' -m '<workspace>/outputs/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct/gguf/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-IQ3_M.gguf' --chunks 20 -c 512 -ngl 99 --kl-divergence-base '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/kld-7c416e92af5ce916.bin' --kl-divergence
'<app>/tools/llama.cpp/bin/llama-perplexity' -m '<workspace>/outputs/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct/gguf/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf' --chunks 20 -c 512 -ngl 99 --kl-divergence-base '<workspace>/cache/gguf/061978f2b9afc59a/kld-7c416e92af5ce916.bin' --kl-divergence
```
